technical_and_design_decisions: Implement the DSL-level timeout and pollInterval as global configuration properties with existing defaults preserved when users do not override them.

Upgrade the Spring Integration dependency to version 4.2.1 using the project's existing dependency-management and build conventions, resolving API or compatibility changes without introducing unrelated framework upgrades.
Refactor JobLaunchingTasklet while preserving its externally observable behavior, job-launching contract, error handling, and transaction semantics unless tests demonstrate an existing defect.

Support inline SpEL expressions at stream-definition scope by evaluating expressions through the existing Spring expression infrastructure and making the behavior available to built-in and custom modules through the common extension path.
Represent the YARN undeployed state as an explicit enum or status value and map the corresponding YARN SPI response to it instead of mapping it to unknown.

Split the admin artifact from Hadoop-distribution-specific libraries using separate modules or artifacts and dependency scopes, so consumers select only the Hadoop distribution integration they require.
Extend automated coverage with focused unit tests, DSL-generation tests, XML-generation tests, compatibility tests, and a final regression suite.
Document job orchestration using the project's existing documentation format and navigation structure, with examples consistent with the implemented DSL.
assumptions: The work is performed by one experienced Java/Spring developer familiar with the existing repository.
The repository, build, CI configuration, and existing test infrastructure are available and generally functional before implementation begins.
The specification describes one software increment in an existing codebase; no greenfield framework or application development is required.
The exact repository version and module layout are not provided, so estimates include moderate codebase discovery and compatibility investigation.
Spring Integration 4.2.1 is compatible with the project's supported Java and Spring versions, or only limited compatibility adjustments are required.
No new public UI, database schema, cloud infrastructure, or production deployment automation is required.
Hadoop distribution-specific artifacts can be separated using the existing build system without rewriting the underlying YARN administration functionality.
Documentation requires technical content and examples but not translation, extensive editorial review, or a complete documentation-site redesign.
Effort includes implementation, developer-level testing, debugging, and final packaging verification, but excludes calendar waiting time and external stakeholder approval delays.

activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing DSL, XML namespace/parser and generator code, stream/module extension points, JobLaunchingTasklet, YARN SPI, admin artifacts, dependency management, tests, and documentation structure. Establish the change impact and implementation plan.

activities.activity_name: Implement global DSL timeout and pollInterval options
activities.activity_description: Add the timeout and pollInterval properties at the Flo DSL level, connect them to runtime configuration and generated representations, preserve defaults, and ensure explicit user values override those defaults.
Add unit and integration tests covering default values, explicit overrides, propagation to runtime components, and relevant DSL/XML or generated-configuration variants.

Update dependency declarations and dependency-management configuration, compile all affected modules, resolve API or transitive-dependency incompatibilities, and verify that existing integration behavior remains intact.

Analyze the current tasklet execution path and performance characteristics, remove avoidable overhead, improve implementation structure and resource handling, and preserve job-launching semantics and error behavior.
Add or update unit and regression tests for successful launches, failures, parameter handling, repeated execution, lifecycle behavior, and the performance-sensitive paths affected by the refactor.

activities.activity_name: Expand DSL and XML generation coverage
activities.activity_description: Create tests for DSL and XML generation variants, including combinations of global options, stream definitions, modules, defaults, overrides, and representative edge cases identified during implementation.

activities.activity_name: Implement inline SpEL expressions at stream-definition level
activities.activity_description: Extend stream-definition parsing, model construction, and runtime or generated configuration so inline SpEL expressions can operate consistently on payloads through the common path used by built-in and custom modules.
Add tests for expression evaluation, payload transformation, expression errors, multiple stream definitions, built-in modules, custom modules, and DSL/XML representations where applicable.

Produce user-facing documentation describing job orchestration concepts, supported workflow patterns, configuration guidance, and representative batch-workflow examples; integrate it into the existing documentation navigation.
Extend the YARN status model and SPI mapping to represent undeployed explicitly, update status conversion and any affected consumers, and retain correct handling of existing statuses.
Add unit and integration-level coverage for undeployed, unknown, deployed, failure, and other existing YARN status mappings, including serialization or presentation paths if present.

activities.activity_name: Split the admin artifact from Hadoop-specific libraries
activities.activity_description: Modify the module and artifact structure so the admin artifact does not package all Hadoop distribution variants together, isolate distribution-specific integrations, and update dependency declarations and public module relationships.

activities.activity_name: Validate artifact packaging and Hadoop variants
activities.activity_description: Update build and packaging tests, verify dependency trees and produced artifacts for supported Hadoop distributions, check runtime class loading, and confirm that existing consumers can select the appropriate artifact.

activities.activity_name: Full regression testing and defect correction
activities.activity_description: Run the complete build and test suite across affected modules, investigate failures caused by the combined changes, correct defects, and perform focused regression runs for DSL, XML, SpEL, YARN, tasklet, and packaging behavior.
Review code and tests for consistency, update changelog or release notes as appropriate, verify generated artifacts and documentation links, and prepare the increment for merge or release.
